{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast bias when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) — model tends to overestimate prices.",
    "Adjust downward for forecasts that overshoot recent highs — especially after spikes in price or sentiment.",
    "Apply mean reversion correction if forecast deviates > ±10% from 5-day moving average of true outcomes.",
    "Lower forecast for early days of new sentiment shifts — model reacts too slowly to sentiment changes.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when sentiment > 0.5 — model underreacts to bullish signals.",
    "Correct for lagged forecasts — if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce next period’s forecast by 5–10%.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in 30-day forecasts — especially when sentiment is neutral or negative — model tends to overpredict recovery."
  ]
}
